allow: PowerShell(Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 3000 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object { $p = Get-Process -Id $_.OwningProcess -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; "$\($_.LocalAddress\):$\($_.LocalPort\) PID=$\($_.OwningProcess\) $\($p.ProcessName\) started $\($p.StartTime\)" })

PowerShell(try { Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 3000 -State Listen -ErrorAction Stop | ForEach-Object { $p = Get-Process -Id $_.OwningProcess -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; "$\($_.LocalAddress\):$\($_.LocalPort\) PID=$\($_.OwningProcess\) $\($p.ProcessName\) started $\($p.StartTime\)" } } catch { "nothing listening on 3000" })

PowerShell(if \(Test-Path .next\) { Get-ChildItem .next | Select-Object Name, LastWriteTime; if \(Test-Path .next\\BUILD_ID\) { "BUILD_ID: $\(Get-Content .next\\BUILD_ID\)" } else { "no BUILD_ID \(dev artifacts\)" } } else { "no .next dir" })

PowerShell(Get-Partition -DiskNumber 1 | ForEach-Object { $v = $_ | Get-Volume -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; [PSCustomObject]@{ Part=$_.PartitionNumber; Letter=$_.DriveLetter; SizeMB=[math]::Round\($_.Size/1MB,1\); Offset=$_.Offset; MbrType=$_.MbrType; Label=$v.FileSystemLabel; FS=$v.FileSystem } } | Format-Table -AutoSize)

PowerShell(Get-Partition -DiskNumber 1 | ForEach-Object { $v = $_ | Get-Volume -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; [PSCustomObject]@{ Part=$_.PartitionNumber; Letter=$_.DriveLetter; SizeGB=[math]::Round\($_.Size/1GB,2\); Label=$v.FileSystemLabel; FS=$v.FileSystem; FreeGB=[math]::Round\($v.SizeRemaining/1GB,2\) } } | Format-Table -AutoSize)
